newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile foreign debt rises to $24.7 bln by end-March.
newsitem.headline: Chile foreign debt rises to $24.7 bln by end-March.

text.p: Chile's foreign debt rose to $24.7 billion on March 31, up $1.6 billion from the debt level reported at the end of December, said the Central Bank in its fortnightly report.
"This higher amount is the result of net new loans of $1.6 billion, a negative adjustment due to currency fluctuations of $49 million and other positive adjustments of $41 million," said the report.
New medium and long term foreign loans totalled $2.5 billion in the first quarter with most of the funds going to the private sector.
Chilean state and private companies issued bonds abroad worth $300 million in the first three months of the year, with 12 percent of the proceeds going to private firms.

Loans to fund investment projects totalled $471 million. Most of the financing from these credits was invested in the mining industry, said the report. ((-- Rodrigo Martinez, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
